text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 14 NOV 18:07Z. ALERT: COASTAL FLOOD WARNING IN RUSSIA; EXTREME HEAT WARNING IN AUSTRALIA; WINTER STORM WARNING IN RUSSIA; HIGH WIND WARNING IN GERMANY, CROATIA; HEAVY RAIN WARNING IN FRANCE, SPAIN, SAUDI ARABIA; SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING IN ITALY, ECUADOR, PARAGUAY; 1 MAJOR FIRE MACEIRA; HOT NIGHT 28C TARAWA, 26C MANILA, 26C LAGOS, 26C ABIDJAN, 26C SANTO DOMING; TROPICAL NIGHT 24C MUMBAI, 23C APIA, 20C CARACAS; HAZARDOUS SMOKE BEIJING; DROUGHT EMERGENCY EUROPE, W AFRICA -GDACS. HIGH 30C SANTO DOMING, LOW -2C REYKJAVIK. GALE 62KMH S OCEAN. 7 MORE FIRES. 100 ZX81S ON WATCH.

image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. Alerts: coastal flood warning RUSSIA; extreme heat warning AUSTRALIA; winter storm warning RUSSIA; high wind warning GERMANY, CROATIA; heavy rain warning FRANCE, SPAIN, SAUDI ARABIA; severe thunderstorm warning ITALY, ECUADOR, PARAGUAY; 1 cyclone; sweltering night W PACIFIC 28C, N ATLANTIC 26C, TROP ATL 26C, W AFRICA 26C, SE ASIA 26C; 1 major fire: MACEIRA; hot night N INDIA 24C, C PACIFIC 23C, CARIBBEAN 20C; hazardous smoke E ASIA; drought emergency EUROPE, W AFRICA (GDACS). Hottest 30C at SANTO DOMING, coldest -2C at REYKJAVIK. Peak gust 62 km/h at S OCEAN. Precipitation: snow or wintry areas. Roughest seas at N PACIFIC. Notable: smoky, unhealthy air over N INDIA, ARABIA. 7 further wildfires burning.
